STAGE 1 (goal): inspect workspace for the exported SID table format, codebook sizes, reference fields, and any prior metric attempts so the proposed metric uses only permitted inputs.
READ: directory listing of the agent workspace and parent round directory (read-only).
OPEN: which SID levels/codebook sizes actually exist and whether per-item reference vectors are exposed as arrays.

STAGE 2 (design decision).
GOAL: pick one metric family that is hyperbolic, non-leaky, fixed-form, and different from prefix-count / collision / same-bucket statistics.
READ: the task contract and the 97-pair facts only. Local data are not readable from this sandbox: glob of the agent directory shows only running.json, stderr.log, progress.jsonl, opencode.json, session.jsonl, and direct reads of those are permission-denied; no SID table or reference arrays are visible.
OBSERVED: pure tree embeddings of a 256-ary code hierarchy collapse to a monotone function of shared-prefix length (the banned statistic); intrinsic bucket statistics are weak (bucket count -0.065); Q_H is reference-based and strong (+0.634) but ordinal and level-1 only.
REASONING: use the frozen reference to define the curved geometry and the SID table only to define the level-1 partition. Place each training item at exp_0 of its unit-normalized reference target vector in the Poincare ball c=1; compute the Karcher (Frechet) barycentre of every level-1 cell; score a size-weighted geodesic silhouette (within-cell cohesion a_k versus distance s_k to the nearest other cell barycentre). This is a curved partition-margin statistic, not a prefix count, not a collision rate, and not a same-bucket ratio; it penalises diffuse cells and near-duplicate regions, which Q_H cannot see.
OPEN: none; constants are fixed (c=1, unit tangent norm, 50-iteration Karcher cap with 1e-8 tolerance); no temperature and no recall-tuned parameter.

FINAL ANSWER (complete proposal; full text printed in the session response, this is the record).
METRIC: HYPERBOLIC_CELL_SILHOUETTE.
TITLE: Size-weighted geodesic silhouette of the level-1 SID partition in the frozen reference geometry.
FORMULA: c=1; B={x in R^d: ||x||<1}; training split T, |T|=N. v_i = frozen reference TARGET rep; u_i=v_i/||v_i||; p_i=exp_0^c(u_i)=tanh(0.5)u_i. d(x,y)=arcosh(1+2||x-y||^2/((1-||x||^2)(1-||y||^2))). For each level-1 code k: C_k={i: code_i[1]=k}, n_k=|C_k|, K=#nonempty. b_k=argmin_{b in B} sum_{i in C_k} d(b,p_i)^2 (Karcher barycentre, 50-iteration Poincare log/exp). a_k=mean_{i in C_k} d(p_i,b_k) if n_k>=2 else 0. s_k=min_{j!=k,n_j>=2} d(b_k,b_j) else 0. q_k=(s_k-a_k)/max(s_k,a_k) if n_k>=2 and max>0 else 0. M=(1/N) sum_k n_k q_k; M=-1 if K=1. One scalar in [-1,1], higher better.
INPUTS: exported SID table (level-1 column only); frozen Issue #126 per-item target representations; training-split index mask. Nothing else (no validation/test interaction, no recall, no Stage-3 output, no fitted quantity).
GEOMETRY: c=1; items placed by exp_0^c on the hyperbolic sphere of radius 1; all distances are Poincare geodesics; cell centres are geodesic Frechet (Karcher) barycentres with Poincare log/exp. Curvature enters in the exp map, in the distance, and in the barycentre (diffuse cells are pulled toward the origin, unlike a Euclidean centroid).
WHY IT TRACKS RECALL: the first SID token is a 256-way choice under a 10-beam; tight cells make it learnable, separated cells make it discriminative and avoid wasting beams on near-duplicate regions. a_k/s_k measure cohesion/separation; Q_H is ordinal and blind to the margin, bucket count is blind to semantics. Level 1 is the only level with ~96 items/code; deeper levels are near item IDs.
COMPUTE: N=24587, d~64-768, K<=256; O(50*N*d) worst case plus O(N) cohesion distances and O(K^2) separations; well under one minute in NumPy.
RISKS: anisotropic reference with a shared mean shrinks variance; level-1-only; Karcher conditioning near the boundary; a few very pure coarse cells can score high; many singleton cells plus one diffuse giant cell drives M to -1; popularity-dominated reference reps.
FAILURE MODE: worst (M near -1) on a level-1 column assigned by a semantic hash (random permutation, item-id modulo 256, or one bucket), because cells are diffuse mixtures, barycentres collapse to the origin, and every q_k is near -1; the K=1 table is -1 by definition.
END METRIC
